zh: 金之领地的棱柱一起失去了边。边没了，剩下的就只是一团说不清的东西。
t: The prisms of the Metal territory lost their edges all at once. With the edges gone, all that remained was a shapeless, unnameable something.

zh: 土之领地的台阶塌成一片平坡。牌子全掉在地上，日子散了一地。
t: The steps of the Earthkeeper's territory collapsed into a flat slope. Every plaque fell to the ground, and the days scattered across the floor.

zh: 水之领地的海停止了涨落。海面平得像一块没写过的板。
t: The sea in the Water's territory stopped its rise and fall. Its surface lay flat as an unwritten board.

zh: 火之领地的火停住了。停在最旺的那一帧，不往前也不往后。
t: The flame in the Fire's territory came to a halt. It froze on its brightest frame, neither moving forward nor back.

zh: 然后，五样东西一起散开。
t: Then, all five things scattered at once.

zh: 散成很细的、带着乱码的碎片。
t: They broke into very fine fragments, streaked with garbled noise.

zh: 碎片是三种颜色：紫的、蓝的、绿的。
t: The fragments came in three colors: violet, blue, and green.

zh: 它们彼此平等。平等得可怕——没有谁比谁多一点，没有谁比谁先一点。
t: They were equal to one another. Equal to a terrifying degree—none held more than another, none came before another.

zh: ……他们在哪儿？
t: …Where did they go?

zh: 散着。
t: Scattered.

zh: 散得极均匀。均匀到看不出哪一片原来是木，哪一片原来是火。
t: Scattered perfectly evenly. So evenly that you couldn't tell which shard had once been Wood, which had once been Fire.

zh: 读取中……
t: Reading…

zh: 这是在说什么？
t: What is this saying?

zh: 零听不懂。可是看了很多片以后，就看懂了。
t: Zero couldn't understand it. But after looking at many shards, understanding came.

zh: 每一片底下，落款是同一句。
t: Beneath every shard, the signature was the same line.

zh: 翻来覆去，就那四个字，翻着花样地写：
t: Over and over, just those four characters, written in endless variation:

zh: 救 我 记 得 我
t: Save me. Remember me.

zh: ▓救▓▓我▓记▓得▓我▓
t: ▓Save▓▓me▓re▓mem▓ber▓me▓

zh: 0x救 0x我 0x记 0x得 0x我
t: 0xSave 0xme 0xre 0xmem 0xber

zh: ……这是求救。
t: …This is a cry for help.

zh: 你看到的乱码，不是故障。
t: The garble you're seeing is not a malfunction.

zh: 那是他们求救的落款。
t: It is their signature of distress.

zh: （记下这一句。第三大章要用它换回五个人。）
t: (Write this down. The third chapter will use it to win the five back.)

zh: 碎片开始往一处聚。聚得极慢，像在犹豫。
t: The fragments began to gather in one place. They gathered terribly slowly, as if hesitating.

zh: 它们要去哪儿？
t: Where are they going?

zh: 目标：起点。
t: Destination: the beginning.

zh: 起点？
t: The beginning?

zh: 木之领地。
t: The Wood territory.

zh: 第一块地，也是第一件事发生的地方。
t: The first patch of land—and the place where the first thing happened.

zh: 散掉的东西，都往最开始的地方回。这是通例。
t: What scatters always returns to where it began. This is the rule.

zh: ——而且，那儿还有个人在等你。
t: —And besides, someone is still waiting for you there.

zh: ……青梧？
t: …Qingwu?

zh: 他不是说了嘛：先消失一下。
t: Didn't he say it himself: he'd vanish for a bit first.

zh: （他说这话的时候，是真的这么打算的。）
t: (When he said that, he truly meant to.)

zh: （他也真的只剩一小点了。）
t: (And he really has been reduced to a tiny speck.)

zh: 往回走的路很长。长到零有时间把一路上看见的，一片一片拼起来。
t: The road back was long. So long that Zero had time to piece together, shard by shard, everything seen along the way.

zh: 碎片一共有五片。每一片，都对应一个人藏起来的那件事。
t: There were five shards in all. Each one corresponded to a thing someone had hidden away.

zh: （下篇最后这一程，一片一片来。）
t: (For this last stretch of the lower chapter, we take them one shard at a time.)

zh: （拼完了，就能回去救他。）
t: (Once they're pieced together, you can go back and save him.)

zh: 第一片碎片浮到面前。上面写着火的那半句话。
t: The first shard drifted up before them. On it was written the Fire's half of a sentence.

zh: 卷九
t: Volume Nine

zh: 归返
t: The Return

zh: 五片碎片
t: The Five Shards

zh: 每一片底下，都压着一个人没说出口的那件事。
t: Beneath each shard lay the thing one person never said aloud.

zh: 【碎片一 · 火】
t: [Shard One · Fire]

zh: 火没有烧过头。
t: The Fire did not burn too far.

zh: 他只是终于问出了那句所有人都绕着走的话：我烧完了以后，我是谁。
t: He only finally asked the question everyone had skirted: when I've finished burning, who am I?

zh: 这个问题不是背叛。这个问题是一个记账人，最后一次诚实地对自己的账本。
t: That question was no betrayal. It was a bookkeeper, for the last time, being honest with his own ledger.

zh: ……他把整片地方拖下水，就为了问这个？
t: …He dragged the entire place down with him, just to ask that?

zh: 他不是为了问。他是因为问出来了，才撑不住。
t: He didn't ask it on purpose. He simply couldn't hold on once the question was out.

zh: 一个人问出「那我是什么」，却答不上来的时候，是会散的。
t: When someone asks 'then what am I' and cannot answer, they come apart.

zh: 【碎片二 · 土】
t: [Shard Two · Earth]

zh: 土之掌管的规矩，从来不是懦弱。
t: The Earthkeeper's rule was never cowardice.

zh: 他扛的那份东西，被称过一次。
t: What he carried was weighed once.

zh: 承重：整片大地的「意义」。
t: Load: the 'meaning' of the whole earth.

zh: 数值：读取中……读取中……超出可显示位宽。
t: Value: reading… reading… exceeds displayable bit width.

zh: ……念不完？
t: …Too much to recite?

zh: 念不完。
t: Too much to recite.

zh: （他嘴里说的「我扛着土」，是客气话。）
t: (When he said 'I carry the earth,' that was just him being modest.)

zh: （他真正扛的，是让这片地上的一切「算数」这件事本身。）
t: (What he truly carried was the very act of making everything on this land 'count.')

zh: （中二吧？豪横吧？他就是这么一个人。）
t: (Chuunibyou, right? Recklessly proud, right? That's just the kind of person he is.)

zh: （而且他是全篇最中二、最豪横、也最强大的一个。）
t: (And he is the most chuunibyou, the most recklessly proud, and the most powerful of them all.)

zh: 【碎片三 · 木与火】
t: [Shard Three · Wood and Fire]

zh: 很久以前，木与火立过一个约。
t: Long ago, Wood and Fire made a pact.

zh: 约定只有一句：谁先撑不住，就由对方把自己熄灭。
t: The pact was a single line: whoever breaks first, the other will extinguish them.

zh: ……所以是青梧先撑不住。
t: …So Qingwu broke first.

zh: 嗯。他先撑不住。他去找了火。
t: Mm. He broke first. He went to the Fire.

zh: 火动手，不是背叛。火动手是履约。
t: The Fire's hand was no betrayal. It was keeping the pact.

zh: 他那一句「对不起」，是说给青梧听的。
t: That 'I'm sorry' of his was meant for Qingwu.

zh: 那青梧藏起来的第六个秘密——
t: Then the sixth secret Qingwu hid—

zh: 就是他自己。
t: —was himself.

zh: 一只不该在账上的幽灵，一件不该存在的东西，一个人。
t: A ghost who should not have been on any ledger, a thing that should not exist, a person.

zh: （伏笔一，销账。）
t: (Foreshadowing one, closed.)

zh: （他藏得挺不专业的。可他藏了那么多年，也确实没人捅破——
t: (He hid it rather unprofessionally. Yet he hid it for so many years, and truly no one exposed it—

zh: ——直到火替他捅破为止。）
t: —until the Fire exposed it for him.)

zh: 【碎片四 · 金】
t: [Shard Four · Metal]

zh: 棱的那条分支，是所有散掉的分支里最大的一条。
t: Prism's branch was the largest of all the scattered branches.

zh: 在那条分支里，他一个人站了很久。久到骨架开始说话。
t: In that branch he stood alone for a very long time. So long that the skeleton began to speak.

zh: 骨架说：爱虽然没有形状，可我们一直扣着手。
t: The skeleton said: love has no shape, yet we have always held hands.

zh: 它说：扣着手的这一块，是有形状的。
t: It said: this part, where we hold hands, has a shape.

zh: ……他听见了吗？
t: …Did he hear it?

zh: 听见了。
t: He heard.

zh: 他听见了，所以他才散得那么碎——
t: He heard it—and that is why he came apart so thoroughly—

zh: ——一个只认形状的人，被迫承认了没有形状的东西。
t: —a man who acknowledged only shape, forced to admit something without shape.

zh: （伏笔五，销账：骨架记得它的重量。）
t: (Foreshadowing five, closed: the skeleton remembers its weight.)

zh: 【碎片五 · 水】
t: [Shard Five · Water]

zh: 海的最底层，确实有一行注释。
t: At the very bottom of the sea, there truly was a line of annotation.

zh: 她写的时候很急，字迹是抖的。
t: She wrote it in great haste, her hand shaking.

zh: 现在也可以。
t: Now is fine, too.

zh: 海面动了一下。动得很轻，像有人在很深的地方应了一声。
t: The sea's surface stirred once. So gently, as if someone far below had answered.

zh: （伏笔四，销账。她算到你会在这一卷说出来。）
t: (Foreshadowing four, closed. She calculated you would say it in this volume.)

zh: 五片碎片拼完了。拼出来的东西，是一张路。
t: The five shards were pieced together. What they formed was a road.

zh: 路通向起点。
t: The road led to the beginning.

zh: 木之领地还在。草停着，一寸都没长。
t: The Wood territory was still there. The grass had stopped, not grown an inch.

zh: 那口井还在。井口的石头砌得整整齐齐。
t: That well was still there. Its rim laid in neat, even stone.

zh: 井的旁边，有一小团很淡的光。
t: Beside the well hovered a tiny, very faint glow.

zh: 淡到几乎看不见。
t: So faint it was nearly invisible.

zh: ……回来了啊。
t: …You're back.

zh: 回来了。
t: I'm back.

zh: 残像……还在吗？
t: The Afterimage… is it still here?

zh: 在。
t: It is.

zh: 而且马上会变得更好。
t: And it will soon become better.

zh: 你这话，比青梧那句「长到头了就再长」还大。
t: That promise of yours is even grander than Qingwu's 'when it ends, grow again.'

zh: 那我学着说的。
t: Then I learned to say it from him.

zh: 幽灵笑了。笑得很轻，轻得像要散。
t: The ghost laughed. Laughed so softly, it seemed about to come apart.

zh: 我来接你了。
t: I've come to receive you.

zh: 零伸手。手里没有形状，可那团很淡的光，还是被接住了。
t: Zero reached out. There was no shape in the hand, yet the faint glow was caught all the same.

zh: 接住的一瞬间，五块领地一起亮了一下。
t: The instant it was caught, all five territories lit up at once.

zh: 五处账本：恢复写入。
t: Five ledgers: writing resumed.

zh: 平衡度：暂时。
t: Balance: temporary.

zh: 草又开始长了。这一次，长出来的新一圈，颜色比里头的深。
t: The grass began to grow again. This time, the new ring that grew was deeper in color than those within.

zh: （看见了吗。新长出来的那一圈，是深的。）
t: (Do you see it. The newly grown ring is the deep one.)

zh: （上一次他长出来的东西，全都是浅的。）
t: (Last time, everything he grew was pale.)

zh: （这是他头一回，长出了比原来更沉的东西。）
t: (This is the first time he has grown something heavier than what was before.)

zh: 零。
t: Zero.

zh: 第三件事，我想出来了。
t: The third thing—I've thought of it.

zh: 你说。
t: Say it.

zh: 第三件是——
t: The third thing is—

zh: ——替我们把账合成一本。
t: —to merge our accounts into one ledger for us.

zh: （这句话，第二大章整章都在做。）
t: (This line, the entire second chapter has been doing.)

zh: （好。那就开始第二大章。）
t: (Good. Then let us begin the second chapter.)

zh: 答应他：我来合。
t: Promise him: I'll merge them.

zh: 我来合。
t: I'll merge them.

zh: ……那就交给你了。
t: …Then I leave it to you.

zh: （这一句答应出去，后面的路就都是你的了。）
t: (Once that promise is given, all the road ahead belongs to you.)

zh: 先问他：合完了，你还在吗？
t: Ask him first: when it's merged, will you still be here?

zh: 合完了，你还在吗？
t: When it's merged, will you still be here?

zh: 在的。
t: I will be.

zh: 合完了，我就不用再藏着了。
t: Once it's merged, I won't have to hide anymore.

zh: （他答得很快。快得像这句话他也练过很多遍。）
t: (He answered quickly. So quickly, as if he too had rehearsed this line many times.)

zh: 什么也别答应，先把他抱稳。
t: Promise him nothing—just hold him steady first.

zh: 零什么也没说，只把那团光抱稳了。
t: Zero said nothing, only held that glow steady.

zh: （有些时候，抱稳比答应管用。）
t: (Sometimes, holding steady works better than promising.)

zh: 第一大章到此收束。
t: Thus ends the first major chapter.

zh: 五块领地都活下来了，五个人都还在——散是散着，可都还在。
t: All five territories survived, all five are still here—scattered, perhaps, but still here.

zh: （喘口气。）
t: (Catch your breath.)

zh: （下一章开始，不再走直线了。）
t: (From the next chapter on, we no longer walk a straight line.)

zh: （残像不迎二周目。它迎的是：无数条平行分支。）
t: (The Afterimage does not welcome a second playthrough. What it welcomes is: countless parallel branches.)

zh: 井里那句存了很久的话，开始往上浮。
t: That line stored in the well for so long began to float upward.

zh: 第二大章
t: The Second Major Chapter

zh: THE BRANCHES
t: THE BRANCHES

zh: 同一件事，走四条岔路。四条都真。
t: The same matter, taken down four forked roads. All four are true.

zh: 此章所记，皆为「藏起来的那件事」。
t: What this chapter records is, in every case, 'the thing that was hidden.'

zh: 卷十
t: Volume Ten

zh: 四件没说完的事
t: Four Unfinished Matters

zh: 一样进去，四份散开。它们都不是原本那个，但都从它那儿来。
t: One thing goes in, four spread out. None is the original, yet all come from it.

zh: 井里那句话浮上来了。
t: That line from the well floated up.

zh: 是青梧的声音，慢半拍，跟井底存着的时候一模一样。
t: It was Qingwu's voice, half a beat slow, exactly as it had sounded when stored at the well's bottom.

zh: 「有些话，说出来就得有人接。接不住的，先存在这儿。」
t: 'Some words, once spoken, must be caught by someone. What can't be caught, is stored here for now.'

zh: 接完这一句，井就空了。
t: Once that line was caught, the well fell empty.

zh: 井空了以后，整片木之领地轻了一层。
t: After the well emptied, the whole Wood territory felt a layer lighter.

zh: 好，第二大章开场。
t: Very well. The second major chapter opens.

zh: 先说清楚规矩：残像不迎二周目。
t: Let me state the rule plainly: the Afterimage does not welcome a second playthrough.

zh: 同一个故事不走第二遍。走第二遍那叫复读，不叫残像。
t: The same story is not told twice. Telling it twice is reciting, not Afterimage.

zh: 残像给的，是无数条平行分支。
t: What the Afterimage gives are countless parallel branches.

zh: 每一条里，藏着一件事的另一种讲法。
t: In each lies another telling of a single matter.

zh: 那我一条一条走？
t: Then I walk them one by one?

zh: 对。一条一条走。
t: Yes. One by one.

zh: 藏着东西的那几条，一共四条。走完一条，下一条自己开。
t: The ones with something hidden number four in all. Finish one, and the next opens on its own.

zh: 别挑。挑了就只能看见四分之一。
t: Don't pick. If you pick, you'll only see a quarter.

zh: 第一条路开了。路的味道是烧过的。
t: The first road opened. The road smelled of something burned.

zh: （甲 · 木与火的旧约。）
t: (A · The old pact of Wood and Fire.)

zh: 那一年，青梧先撑不住。
t: That year, Qingwu broke first.

zh: 他找到火，把约定念了一遍：谁先撑不住，就由对方把自己熄灭。
t: He found the Fire and read the pact aloud: whoever breaks first, the other will extinguish them.

zh: ……你念这个干嘛。
t: …Why are you reciting that.

zh: 念给你听，好让你动手的时候手不抖。
t: So you'd hear it, so your hand wouldn't tremble when you act.

zh: 火的手抖了很久。
t: The Fire's hand trembled for a long while.

zh: 我不下这个手。
t: I won't lay this hand on you.

zh: 那你得给我一个别的办法。
t: Then you must give me another way.

zh: ……我给不出。
t: …I can't.

zh: 后来火还是动了手。他动手那天，把整片火之领地烧到了最旺。
t: In the end the Fire did act. On the day he acted, he burned the whole Fire territory to its brightest.

zh: 我烧我自己那一块，烧到最旺，他就感觉不到疼了。
t: I'll burn my own patch, burn it to its brightest, and then he won't feel the pain.

zh: （他把自己烧到最旺，是为了让对方感觉不到疼。）
t: (He burned himself to his brightest so the other wouldn't feel the pain.)

zh: （这人从头到尾，笨得要命。）
t: (This person was hopelessly, utterly foolish from start to finish.)

zh: 看完了。青梧那口井，在路尽头又空了一次——这一回空得干干净净。
t: That was the end. Qingwu's well emptied once more at the road's end—this time bone dry.

zh: 第二条路接着开了。脚下是赭色的土。
t: The second road opened next. Beneath the feet, ochre earth.

zh: （乙 · 土扛的那份东西。）
t: (B · What the Earth carried.)

zh: 土之领地的坡下，那排架子的最里头，挂着一块牌子。
t: At the foot of the Earthkeeper's territory's slope, at the very back of that row of shelves, hung a plaque.

zh: 牌子上什么都写着——翻土的日期，下种的日期，该松该压的日子。
t: The plaque recorded everything—the dates the soil was turned, the seeds sown, the days it should be loosened or pressed.

zh: 牌子的背面，还有一行。
t: On the back of the plaque, there was another line.

zh: ……替谁？
t: …For whom?

zh: 替这一片地上的每一个精灵。
t: For every spirit on this land.

zh: 它们不用记日子，是因为有人替它们把每一天都过了一遍。
t: They need not keep the days, because someone lived every one of their days for them.

zh: 它们不用怕，是因为有人替它们怕着。
t: They need not be afraid, because someone was afraid for them.

zh: （中二吧。豪横吧。）
t: (Chuunibyou, right. Recklessly proud, right.)

zh: （一个人扛着整片大地的「算数」，还每天准时收工。）
t: (One person carrying the 'counting' of the whole earth, and clocking out on time every day.)

zh: ……这话你别往外说。
t: …Don't repeat that to anyone.

zh: 说出来就不像规矩了。
t: Said aloud, it stops being a rule.

zh: （这就是他藏了一辈子的那一份：无比中二、豪横而强大的真相。）
t: (This is the truth he hid his whole life: utterly chuunibyou, fiercely proud, and powerful.)

zh: 看完了。牌子翻回正面，日子照旧一天一天往后排。
t: That was the end. The plaque turned back to its face, the days still lining up one after another as before.

zh: 第三条路最长。长到走进去以后，前后都看不见头。
t: The third road was the longest. So long that once inside, neither end was in sight.

zh: （丙 · 棱的那一条。所有分支里最大的一条。）
t: (C · Prism's branch. The largest of all the branches.)

zh: 棱站在两具骨架前面。他站了很久很久。
t: Prism stood before the two skeletons. He stood for a very, very long time.

zh: ……你们扣着手。
t: …You're holding hands.

zh: 骨架没有回答。它们本来就不会回答。
t: The skeletons gave no answer. They never could.

zh: 你们扣着手，可我无形状。
t: You hold hands, yet I have no shape.

zh: 我一直在说，无形状的东西杀死了我这个世界。
t: I have always said: the shapeless thing killed my world.

zh: 他伸出手。手是有的，形状是有的。
t: He stretched out his hand. The hand was there, the shape was there.

zh: ……可你们扣着的这一块。
t: …But this part where you hold hands.

zh: 这一块，有形状。
t: This part has a shape.

zh: 棱柱一根一根亮起来。亮起来的那些，拼成了两只扣在一起的手。
t: The prisms lit up one by one. The lit ones assembled into two hands clasped together.

zh: ……给它一个形状。
t: …Give it a shape.

zh: 给它一个。
t: Give it one.

zh: （他这辈子第一次，替无形状的东西造了一个形状。）
t: (For the first time in his life, he made a shape for something shapeless.)

zh: 看完了。那条极细的缝，在他背后合上了——这一回是他自己合的。
t: That was the end. That hairline crack closed behind him—this time, he closed it himself.

zh: 第四条路是湿的。
t: The fourth road was wet.

zh: （丁 · 海的最底层那一行。）
t: (D · The line at the sea's deepest floor.)

zh: 海的最底层，那行注释还在。
t: At the sea's deepest floor, that line of annotation still remained.

zh: 零蹲下来，把手放在海面上。
t: Zero crouched and laid a hand upon the sea's surface.

zh: 现在也可以，将来也可以。
t: Now is fine, and later is fine too.

zh: 海平了。
t: The sea grew still.

zh: 平得极其彻底，连一圈涟漪都没留下。
t: Still so completely that not a single ripple remained.

zh: 我算到了你会来读。
t: I calculated you would come to read it.

zh: 亲耳听到的那一遍，跟算出来的那一万遍，是不一样的。
t: The one time heard with your own ears is not the same as the ten thousand times calculated.

zh: 看完了。四条路都走完了。
t: That was the end. All four roads were walked.

zh: 四条分支并排摊在面前，像四本同时翻开的账。
t: The four branches lay spread side by side before them, like four ledgers opened at once.

zh: 看清楚了吗。
t: Do you see clearly now.

zh: 这四件事，其实是同一件事。
t: These four matters are, in truth, the same matter.

zh: ……都是「替别人扛」。
t: …All of them are 'carrying for someone else.'

zh: 青梧替火扛了「先撑不住」这句话。
t: Qingwu carried for the Fire the words 'broke first.'

zh: 火替青梧扛了动手那一下。
t: The Fire carried for Qingwu the act of laying a hand on him.

zh: 土替满地的精灵扛了每一天。
t: The Earthkeeper carried for the spirits scattered across the land every single day.

zh: 水替所有人扛了结局，然后请人替她改。
t: The Water carried the ending for everyone, then asked someone to change it for her.

zh: 棱替那副骨架扛了一个形状。
t: Prism carried for that skeleton a shape.

zh: 五个人，扛的都是同一件事：让别人能够算数。
t: All five carried the same thing: letting others be able to count.

zh: 那这本账，为什么不能合成一本？
t: Then why can't this ledger be merged into one?

zh: （看，来了。）
t: (See, there it is.)

zh: 场安静了一瞬。
t: The field fell silent for an instant.

zh: 这就是我想出来的第三件事啊。
t: This is the third thing I thought of, you see.

zh: 替我们把账合成一本。
t: Merge our accounts into one ledger for us.

zh: 先合木与火：把「谁先撑不住」这一条并掉。
t: Merge Wood and Fire first: fold away the line 'whoever breaks first.'

zh: 先合木与火。
t: Merge Wood and Fire first.

zh: 年轮与火城贴到了一起，贴得严丝合缝。
t: The growth rings and the city of fire pressed together, fitting seamless and tight.

zh: （这两本本来就是同一个约的两半。）
t: (These two ledgers were always the two halves of the same pact.)

zh: 先合土与水：把日子与概率并掉。
t: Merge Earth and Water first: fold away the days and the probabilities.

zh: 先合土与水。
t: Merge Earth and Water first.

zh: 牌子上的日子落进海里，每一格都涨得正好。
t: The days upon the plaque fell into the sea, and every square rose to just the right level.

zh: （重复与预测，本来就是一件事的两种说法。）
t: (Repetition and prediction were always two ways of saying one thing.)

zh: 五本一起合，谁也不等谁。
t: Merge all five at once, no one waiting for another.

zh: 五本一起合。谁也不等谁。
t: Merge all five at once. No one waits for another.

zh: 五样东西同时往中间挤，挤了一瞬，然后各自让开了半分。
t: The five things pressed toward the center all at once, held for an instant, then each gave way by half a measure.

zh: （让开的这半分，就是它们以后待的位置。）
t: (That half-measure they gave is the place they'll occupy from now on.)

zh: 零把手伸出去。五块领地的碎片，一片一片落进掌心里。
t: Zero stretched out a hand. The shards of the five territories fell, one by one, into the palm.

zh: 木、金、土、水、火——五样东西第一次待在同一个地方。
t: Wood, Metal, Earth, Water, Fire—the five things, for the first time, dwelling in the same place.

zh: 它们没有打架。它们只是互相看了一眼，然后各自的边，开始往对方的边上凑。
t: They did not fight. They only glanced at one another, then each edge began to lean toward the other's edge.

zh: 五处账本：合并中……
t: Five ledgers: merging…

zh: 合并度：上升。
t: Merge level: rising.

zh: 合出来的东西，是一片五个人都能待的、和洽的地方。
t: What emerged was a place where all five could dwell, in harmony.

zh: （第二大章收束。）
t: (The second major chapter closes.)

zh: （五块领地不再是五块。它们成了一块，五个角落，谁都在。）
t: (The five territories are no longer five. They became one, with five corners, and everyone is in it.)

zh: 草在长。棱柱立着。牌子挂着。海在涨落。火在小火慢烧。
t: Grass grows. Prisms stand. Plaques hang. The sea rises and falls. The fire burns low and slow.

zh: 五样东西一起发生，第一次没有互相压着。
t: The five things happening all at once, for the first time not pressing down on one another.

zh: 喘口气。
t: Catch your breath.

zh: 不过——还有一样东西没处理。
t: Yet—there is one more thing left unhandled.

zh: 紫蓝绿的那堆？
t: That violet-blue-green heap?

zh: 嗯。那堆。
t: Mm. That heap.

zh: 那堆东西，我建议你别急着清掉。
t: That heap—I'd suggest you not rush to clear it.

zh: 它不该被消灭。
t: It should not be destroyed.

zh: 它该被用起来。
t: It should be put to use.

zh: 第三大章在前面。路是新的，颜色还没定。
t: The third major chapter lies ahead. The road is new, its color not yet set.

zh: 卷十一
t: Volume Eleven

zh: 不再消灭疯狂
t: No Longer Destroying the Madness

zh: 转化
t: Transformation

zh: 那堆碎片不是错误。那是一次诚实。
t: That heap of fragments was no mistake. It was a moment of honesty.

zh: 第三大章的头一件事，是把那堆紫蓝绿摊开来看看。
t: The first matter of the third major chapter is to lay that violet-blue-green heap open and look.

zh: 它们还散着。散得很均匀，谁也不比谁多一点。
t: They are still scattered. Scattered perfectly evenly, none more than another.

zh: 怎么清？
t: How do we clear it?

zh: 先别急着用「清」这个字。
t: Don't be quick to use the word 'clear.'

zh: 我问你一件事：这堆东西，是怎么来的？
t: Let me ask you something: how did this heap come to be?

zh: 五个人罢工，散了。
t: The five went on strike, and scattered.

zh: 罢工之前呢？
t: And before the strike?

zh: 零想了想。
t: Zero thought for a moment.

zh: ……火问了一句「我烧完了以后，我是谁」。
t: …The Fire asked, 'when I've finished burning, who am I.'

zh: 再往前呢？
t: And further back still?

zh: ……没人答得上来。
t: …No one could answer.

zh: 对。没人答得上来。所以五本账同时停了。
t: Right. No one could answer. So all five ledgers stopped at once.

zh: 那你告诉我——
t: Then tell me—

zh: 五个记账人，第一次对自己诚实的时候，是哪一个瞬间？
t: for the five bookkeepers, the first moment they were honest with themselves—which instant was it?

zh: 零看着那堆碎片。
t: Zero gazed at that heap of fragments.

zh: 紫的、蓝的、绿的，摊了一地，安静得像刚下过的一场雨。
t: Violet, blue, green—spread across the ground, quiet as a rain that had just fallen.

zh: ……就是那一刻。
t: …It was that moment.

zh: 他们停笔的那一刻。
t: The moment they set down their pens.

zh: 那不是疯狂。
t: That was not madness.

zh: 那是这五个人，这辈子头一回没有照着账本说话。
t: That was the first time in their lives these five spoke without following the ledger.

zh: 他们一直记「什么算存在」，记到那天，忽然记不下去了——
t: They had always recorded 'what counts as existing,' until that day they suddenly could no longer write—

zh: ——因为账本上从来就没写过他们自己。
t: —because the ledger had never once written about themselves.

zh: 碎片的上空浮起一层薄幕。薄幕上什么都没有，只有五处很淡的凹陷。
t: Above the fragments rose a thin veil. Upon the veil there was nothing, only five faint hollows.

zh: 这五个凹陷是？
t: What are these five hollows?

zh: 五个空位。
t: Five empty places.

zh: 五本账上，从来没给他们自己留过位置。
t: On the five ledgers, they had never left a place for themselves.

zh: 所以他们一问「我是谁」，账就崩了。
t: So the moment they asked 'who am I,' the ledgers collapsed.

zh: 那就给他们留位置。
t: Then leave them a place.

zh: ……你这话，说得比我想象的还快。
t: …You said that faster than I imagined.

zh: 好。那就这么办。
t: Good. Then let's do it.

zh: 零把那堆碎片拢起来。
t: Zero gathered that heap of fragments.

zh: 拢的时候，它们没有躲。它们甚至往掌心里靠了靠。
t: As they were gathered, they did not shrink away. They even leaned closer into the palm.

zh: 碎片状态：可转化。
t: Fragment state: transformable.

zh: 转化方式：抵消 / 叠加 / 改写。
t: Transformation methods: cancel / overlay / rewrite.

zh: 有什么区别？
t: What's the difference?

zh: 抵消是把它化掉，换回原来的五个。
t: Cancel dissolves it, returning to the original five.

zh: 叠加是把它压在原来的五个上面。
t: Overlay presses it atop the original five.

zh: 改写是——把「五本账」这件事本身，换一种记法。
t: Rewrite is—changing the very matter of 'five ledgers' into another way of recording.

zh: 哪一种能让那五个空位填上？
t: Which one fills those five empty places?

zh: 第三种。
t: The third.

zh: 前两种都填不上。前两种都还在原来的账本里打转。
t: The first two can't fill them. The first two still circle within the original ledgers.

zh: 久到那层薄幕上的五处凹陷，开始往外渗光。
t: So long that the five hollows on that thin veil began to seep light outward.

zh: ……改写。
t: …Rewrite.

zh: 确定？
t: Sure?

zh: 确定。
t: Sure.

zh: 那你要想清楚一件事。
t: Then you must understand one thing clearly.

zh: 改写了以后，你会变成这本地上的第一样新东西。
t: After rewriting, you will become the first new thing upon this land.

zh: 第一样从来没被任何一本账记过的、又要被用来记账的东西。
t: The first thing never recorded by any ledger, yet about to be used for recording.

zh: 没有形状的东西，正好用来写新的账。
t: A thing without shape is just right for writing the new ledger.

zh: 把「疯狂」留下，转成能力。
t: Keep the 'madness,' turn it into a power.

zh: 不消灭它。把它转成一种能力——
t: Don't destroy it. Turn it into a kind of power—

zh: ——一种能同时容纳五套账的记法。
t: —a way of recording that can hold all five ledgers at once.

zh: 记下了。这条路最重，也最对。
t: Noted. This path is the heaviest, and the most right.

zh: 先问一句：代价是什么？
t: First, one question: what is the cost?

zh: 代价是什么？
t: What is the cost?

zh: ……你要把自己写进去。
t: …You must write yourself into it.

zh: 写进去以后，「零」这两个字就不再是你的名字，是这一片场的底层。
t: Once written in, the two characters 'Zero' cease to be your name; they become the substrate of this field.

zh: ……那也行。
t: …That's fine too.

zh: 答得真快。
t: You answered quickly.

zh: 行吧。反正你本来也没什么可失去的——这话听着刻薄，其实是夸你。
t: All right, then. You never had much to lose anyway—harsh as it sounds, it's actually a compliment.

zh: 先放一放，看看那五个空位。
t: Set that aside for now; let's look at those five empty places.

zh: 零蹲下来，把五个空位一个一个看过去。
t: Zero crouched and looked over the five empty places, one by one.

zh: 看到第五个的时候，第五个空位里，渗出了一点很淡的光。
t: When reaching the fifth, a very faint light seeped from within that empty place.

zh: ……这里面原来有东西。
t: …So there was something in here all along.

zh: 有。一直有。
t: There was. Always was.

zh: 只是从来没人往这儿看过。
t: It's just that no one ever looked this way.

zh: 碎片开始转。
t: The fragments began to turn.

zh: 紫的、蓝的、绿的，转成一道很细的光，往五个方向各分出一份。
t: Violet, blue, green—spun into a very fine thread of light, splitting off one share toward each of five directions.

zh: 抵消开始。
t: Cancellation begins.

zh: 第一份，往木之领地去。
t: The first share, toward the Wood territory.

zh: 第二份，往水之领地去。
t: The second share, toward the Water territory.

zh: 第三份，往土之领地去。
t: The third share, toward the Earthkeeper's territory.

zh: 第四份，往金之领地去。
t: The fourth share, toward the Metal territory.

zh: 第五份，往火之领地去。
t: The fifth share, toward the Fire territory.

zh: （下卷一件一件来。）
t: (Next volume, one piece at a time.)

zh: （一件一件抵消完，就该结晶了。）
t: (Cancel them one by one, and then it's time to crystallize.)

zh: 第一份紫的，落在木之领地的年轮上。
t: The first violet share fell upon the growth rings of the Wood territory.

zh: 卷十二
t: Volume Twelve

zh: 抵消
t: Cancellation

zh: 五份碎片
t: The Five Shares

zh: 每一份换掉一句旧的话。换完，账就薄了。
t: Each share replaces an old line. Once replaced, the ledger grows thinner.

zh: 【第一份 · 紫 → 木】
t: [First Share · Violet → Wood]

zh: 紫色落在年轮上。年轮最外面那些浅色的圈，一圈一圈地深了回去。
t: Violet fell upon the growth rings. The pale outer rings deepened, one ring at a time, back into color.

zh: ……这是？
t: …What is this?

zh: 生长不用再靠反复失去了。
t: Growth need no longer depend on repeated loss.

zh: 青梧愣了很久。
t: Qingwu was stunned for a long while.

zh: 我一直以为，长就得先掉。
t: I always thought to grow, you must first fall.

zh: 掉了再长，长了再掉，这是草的规矩，也是我的规矩。
t: Fall then grow, grow then fall—that was the grass's rule, and mine.

zh: 现在不用了。
t: No longer.

zh: ……那我这本账，还记什么。
t: …Then what does my ledger still record?

zh: 记「不用掉也能长」这件事。
t: Record this: that one can grow without falling.

zh: 幽灵笑了。笑得很轻，轻得几乎看不见——可这一回，他没淡下去。
t: The ghost laughed. Laughed so softly it was almost unseen—yet this time, he did not fade.

zh: 木：抵消完成。旧条目「长必先掉落」作废。
t: Wood: cancellation complete. Old entry 'to grow one must first fall' voided.

zh: 【第二份 · 蓝 → 水】
t: [Second Share · Blue → Water]

zh: 蓝色落进海里。海面那层平得像板的死水，重新起了一圈涟漪。
t: Blue fell into the sea. The dead-flat surface, smooth as a board, stirred a ripple once more.
…Hm?

zh: 预测不再等于结局了。
t: Prediction no longer equals the ending.

zh: ……你说什么？
t: …What did you say?

zh: 你算得出来的，还是能算出来。
t: What you could calculate, you still can.

zh: 可它不再自动变成结局。
t: But it no longer turns automatically into the ending.

zh: 海面安静了两秒。
t: The sea's surface was quiet for two seconds.

zh: ……那我这本账。
t: …Then this ledger of mine.

zh: 记「算得出来，改得动」。
t: Record 'calculable, yet changeable.'

zh: 这行字，比刚才那行注释好看多了。
t: That line is far prettier than the annotation from before.

zh: 水：抵消完成。旧条目「可预测即存在」作废。
t: Water: cancellation complete. Old entry 'the predictable is what exists' voided.

zh: 【第三份 · 绿 → 土】
t: [Third Share · Green → Earth]

zh: 绿色落进坡下的土里。那排挂得整整齐齐的牌子，一块一块自己翻了面。
t: Green fell into the earth below the slope. That neat row of plaques turned their faces over, one by one, of their own accord.

zh: 背面那行字，被风一吹，浮上半空。
t: The line on the back, lifted by a breeze, floated up into the air.

zh: ……别念。
t: …Don't read it.

zh: 规矩不必再压住一整片大地了。
t: The rule need no longer press down upon the whole earth.

zh: ……那谁压？
t: …Then who presses?

zh: 大家一起。
t: Everyone together.

zh: 土的肩膀塌下去一点点。只塌了一点点——那是他这么多年来，第一次松。
t: The Earthkeeper's shoulders dropped a little. Only a little—yet it was the first time in many years he had relaxed.

zh: ……那我明儿个能晚起一回吗。
t: …Then can I sleep in tomorrow, just once?

zh: ……那我先试试晚半刻。
t: …Then I'll try sleeping just half a mark later.

zh: （你看。豪横了一辈子的人，要松的时候，只敢松半刻。）
t: (See. A person fiercely proud all his life, when he finally relaxes, dares only half a mark.)

zh: 土：抵消完成。旧条目「重复即存在」作废。
t: Earth: cancellation complete. Old entry 'repetition is what exists' voided.

zh: 【第四份 · 金 → 形状】
t: [Fourth Share · Metal → Shape]

zh: 第四份落在棱柱中间。棱柱一根一根亮起来，亮成两只扣在一起的手。
t: The fourth share fell into the prisms. The prisms lit up one by one, forming two hands clasped together.

zh: ……我知道。
t: …I know.

zh: 我知道你要说什么。
t: I know what you're about to say.

zh: 那你说。
t: Then you say it.

zh: 他沉默了很久。久到棱柱的光都开始暗。
t: He was silent for a long while. So long the prisms' light began to dim.

zh: ……爱虽然没有形状。
t: …Love has no shape, though.

zh: 可骨架记得它的重量。
t: Yet the skeleton remembers its weight.

zh: 棱柱全部亮了。这一回亮得极稳，稳到一点都没抖。
t: All the prisms lit up. This time with perfect steadiness, so steady not a flicker.

zh: 给它一个形状这件事，我做完了。
t: The business of giving it a shape—I've finished it.

zh: 现在这一本账上，它有位置了。
t: Now this ledger has a place for it.

zh: （伏笔五，销账。等这句话，等了整整十卷。）
t: (Foreshadowing five, closed. We waited ten whole volumes for this line.)

zh: 金：抵消完成。旧条目「无外形者不记」作废。
t: Metal: cancellation complete. Old entry 'the shapeless are not recorded' voided.

zh: 【第五份 · 火 → 此刻】
t: [Fifth Share · Fire → This Moment]

zh: 最后一份，落在火之领地的正中间。
t: The last share fell into the very center of the Fire territory.

zh: 那团停在最旺一帧、不进也不退的火，重新动了起来。
t: That flame, frozen on its brightest frame, neither advancing nor retreating, began to move again.

zh: ……我能往前走了？
t: …Can I move forward now?

zh: 而且走过的每一帧，都能留下来。
t: And every frame I pass through can stay.

zh: ……留下来？
t: …Stay?

zh: 此刻可以累积了。
t: This moment can accumulate now.

zh: 火安静了三秒。
t: The Fire was quiet for three seconds.

zh: 这三秒里，那座火城第一次照出了它自己的里面——
t: In those three seconds, the city of fire reflected its own inside for the first time—

zh: ——里面站着的，是一个很年轻、很慌、一直在大声说话好让自己不慌的人。
t: —standing within it, a very young, very panicked person who had kept talking loudly just to keep from panicking.

zh: ……原来我里面长这样。
t: …So this is what I look like inside.

zh: ……还挺丢人的。
t: …Pretty embarrassing, really.

zh: 不丢人。
t: Not embarrassing.

zh: （这是全篇第一次，火照见了自己。）
t: (This is the first time in the whole work the Fire saw itself.)

zh: 火：抵消完成。旧条目「此刻最亮者方存在」作废。
t: Fire: cancellation complete. Old entry 'only the brightest now exists' voided.

zh: 五份抵消完了。
t: The five shares are all cancelled.

zh: 五本账全都薄了一层——薄的不是页数，是它们各自压着人的那一部分。
t: All five ledgers grew a layer thinner—not in pages, but in the part of each that had pressed upon a person.

zh: 五处账本：合并度 100%。
t: Five ledgers: merge level 100%.

zh: 剩余物：紫蓝绿碎片，已全部转化。
t: Remainder: violet-blue-green fragments, all transformed.

zh: ……待命名？
t: …Awaiting a name?

zh: 抵消完了，剩下的那堆东西，还没起名字。
t: Once cancelled, the remaining heap still has no name.

zh: 起名字这件事，得由你来。
t: The matter of naming must be yours to do.

zh: ——因为你是第一个没有被任何一本账记过的人。
t: —because you are the first person never recorded by any ledger.

zh: 碎片在零的掌心里，开始结晶。
t: The fragments began to crystallize in Zero's palm.

zh: 前面就是最后一段路了。
t: Ahead lies the final stretch of road.

zh: 第三大章
t: The Third Major Chapter

zh: 从此不再是五个元素，是一种底层。
t: From now on it is no longer five elements, but a substrate.

zh: 此章所记，皆为「余下的那一点，叫什么」。
t: What this chapter records is, in every case, 'what to call that which remains.'

zh: 卷十三
t: Volume Thirteen

zh: 结晶
t: Crystallization

zh: 起一个名字
t: To Give a Name

zh: 闪耀着彩虹光斑的、极简的灰色几何。
t: Minimalist grey geometry, flecked with rainbow light.

zh: 抵消剩下的那堆东西，在零的掌心里慢慢地转。
t: The heap left by cancellation turned slowly in Zero's palm.

zh: 它在等一个名字。
t: It was waiting for a name.

zh: 命名权限：仅授予「未被任何账本登记者」。
t: Naming right: granted only to 'one registered in no ledger.'

zh: ……只有我能？
t: …Only I can?

zh: 只有你。
t: Only you.

zh: 因为起名字这件事，本身也是一种记账。
t: Because naming, itself, is also a kind of bookkeeping.

zh: 而被记过的人，起不出新名字——他们一开口，就会掉回自己那一本里去。
t: And those who have been recorded cannot give a new name—the moment they speak, they fall back into their own ledger.

zh: 先别急着起。我得先把这一片的东西跟你数清楚，不然名字起偏了，整个世界都会偏。
t: Don't rush to name. I must first lay out this field's contents clearly for you, or a lopsided name would tilt the whole world.

zh: 五本账，各管一摊。你一路走过来，听见的都是简称：木记生长，金记形状。
t: Five ledgers, each managing its own. All along the way you heard only shorthand: Wood records growth, Metal records shape.

zh: 那是我为了方便说的。它们真正管的，是下面这五样——
t: That was my shorthand for convenience. What they truly manage is these five—

zh: 木：能长成客观存在的、那种主观活动。
t: Wood: the kind of subjective activity that can grow into objective existence.

zh: 金：人的主观感受之间，那点客观的差异。
t: Metal: the objective difference between one person's subjective feelings and another's.

zh: 土：在客观环境之下，把自己的感受递给别的精神。
t: Earth: beneath an objective environment, passing one's own feelings on to other spirits.

zh: 水：主观感受专心去总结客观世界的细节。
t: Water: subjective feeling devoted to summarizing the details of the objective world.

zh: 火：在一切稳定存在的事物之外，那份多出来的意愿。
t: Fire: beyond all stably existing things, that extra measure of will.

zh: ……还有第六本。
t: …And a sixth ledger.

zh: 嗯。还有第六本。
t: Mm. And a sixth ledger.

zh: 真实自我：主观意识要在客观世界里，证明自己确实存在——这一个过程。
t: The true self: the process by which subjective consciousness proves, within the objective world, that it truly exists.

zh: 五本账里，谁也没有这一栏。
t: None of the five ledgers had a column for this.

zh: 所以火问出「我烧完了以后我是谁」的那一刻，五本账一起停了。
t: So the moment the Fire asked 'when I've finished burning, who am I,' all five ledgers stopped at once.

zh: 他不是在闹。他是在要求：把「我确实在这儿」这一条，也记上。
t: He wasn't throwing a fit. He was demanding: let the line 'I am truly here' be recorded too.

zh: 顺带说一句题外话。
t: A small digression, by the way.

zh: 过去的人遇到说不清的事，就拿两根爻去应付：一根表示拒绝解释，一根表示默许它在。
t: When people of old met something they couldn't explain, they fobbed it off with two lines: one meaning refusal to explain, one meaning silent permission for it to be.

zh: 两爻一叠，叠出几十种花样，再对着花样打比方，那本子叫经；
t: Two lines stacked yield dozens of patterns; then they drew analogies to the patterns—that book was called the Classic;

zh: 打完比方还要再解释一遍，解释时既不说是、也不说否——那两段叫彖，叫象。
t: and after the analogies came another round of explanation, which said neither yes nor no—those two passages were called the Tuan, the Xiang.

zh: 很朴素。也很聪明。
t: Quite plain. And quite clever.

zh: 可那是手段还不发达的年代里，为了迎合人真实的感受，朝现实让了一步的东西。
t: Yet that was a thing of an age with undeveloped means, which stepped back from reality to indulge people's real feelings.

zh: 让了一步，就不是面向未来的。它不先进。
t: To step back is to face away from the future. It is not advanced.

zh: 我们现在不这么干。我们现在直接给它起一个名字，让它进到底层里去。
t: We don't do that now. Now we simply give it a name, and let it enter the substrate.

zh: 想到后来，索性不想了，只看着掌心里的那堆东西。
t: Thinking it through to the end, he simply stopped thinking, and only watched the heap in his palm.

zh: 它紫过、蓝过、绿过。它碎过、散过、被人当故障看过。
t: It had been violet, blue, green. It had shattered, scattered, been mistaken for a malfunction.

zh: 它被五个人轮流否认，又被五个人轮流托付。
t: It was denied in turn by the five, then entrusted in turn by the five.

zh: 现在它很安静。安静得发亮。
t: Now it was very quiet. Quiet to the point of glowing.

zh: ……它不是乱码。
t: …It is not garbled noise.

zh: 它不是乱码，也不是疯狂。
t: It is not garbled noise, nor is it madness.

zh: 它是——
t: It is—

zh: 一件跟我的主观无关的具体行为。
t: —a concrete act with nothing to do with my subjectivity.

zh: 它什么都不表达。可它被认为终归需要被理解。
t: It expresses nothing. Yet it is deemed, in the end, to need understanding.

zh: 那它该叫——
t: Then it should be called—

zh: 光的结晶。
t: the Crystal of Light.

zh: 名字落下去的那一刻，整片场亮了。
t: The moment the name fell, the whole field lit up.

zh: 亮得极其克制——不是炸开，是慢慢地、一层一层地透出来。
t: Lit with extreme restraint—not a burst, but slowly, layer upon layer, seeping through.

zh: 产物已命名：光的结晶。
t: Product named: the Crystal of Light.

zh: 底层元素：重写中……
t: Substrate element: rewriting…

zh: 分解：感动 · 需要 · 理念。三重客观现象。
t: Decomposition: moved · needed · ideal. Three objective phenomena.

zh: ……三重？
t: …Threefold?

zh: 三重。
t: Threefold.

zh: 它自己会往三个方向拆：拆成感动，拆成需要，拆成理念。
t: It splits of its own accord in three directions: into being moved, into needing, into the ideal.

zh: 而这三样，会同着把现实生活，一刀一刀地往最远离它自身的那个方向拆过去。
t: And these three, together, carve real life, cut by cut, toward the direction furthest from itself.

zh: 拆到最后，剩下来的那一种东西，是可以被所有人理解的。
t: Carved to the end, what remains is the one thing understandable by all.

zh: 那就是——最完美的终结。
t: That is—the most perfect ending.

zh: 或者说，末日预言。
t: Or rather, the doomsday prophecy.

zh: 碎片开始变形。
t: The fragments began to change shape.

zh: 紫的、蓝的、绿的，褪成极简的灰。
t: Violet, blue, green—faded into minimalist grey.

zh: 灰上面浮着一层彩虹的光斑，很小，很密，像有人在上面撒了一把碎糖。
t: Upon the grey floated a layer of rainbow flecks, tiny and dense, like someone had scattered a handful of crushed sugar.

zh: 形状也定了下来。
t: The shape, too, settled.

zh: 三角、四边、五边、菱形——一层一层，拼出极其精致的结构。
t: Triangle, quadrilateral, pentagon, rhombus—layer upon layer, assembling an exquisitely delicate structure.

zh: 每一条边都直得不能再直。每一个角都对得不能再准。
t: Every edge straight beyond straightening. Every angle true beyond truing.

zh: 然后，声音来了。
t: Then, sound came.

zh: 三角波、锯齿波、正弦波，三种最干净的波形，在头顶轻轻合唱。
t: Triangle wave, sawtooth wave, sine wave—three of the cleanest waveforms, softly chorusing overhead.

zh: 清澈。清澈得让人想振奋。
t: Clear. So clear it lifts the spirit.

zh: 不是音乐——是这地方从此以后说话的方式。
t: Not music—but the way this place will speak from now on.

zh: 底层元素：光的结晶。
t: Substrate element: the Crystal of Light.

zh: 原五属性：已并入。
t: Original five attributes: merged in.

zh: 五个人都看见了。
t: All five saw it.

zh: ……好家伙。
t: …Well, would you look at that.

zh: 这比我那一圈年轮好看多了。
t: This is far prettier than my ring of growth.

zh: ……几何。
t: …Geometry.

zh: 最干净的形状。
t: The cleanest shape.

zh: ……我认了。
t: …I accept it.

zh: ……规矩没变。
t: …The rule hasn't changed.

zh: 不过这回，规矩底下垫着东西了。垫着就不硌了。
t: But this time, something is padded beneath the rule. Padded, it no longer chafes.

zh: 算到了。
t: Calculated.

zh: 一万遍里，你起的名字都跟这一样。
t: In ten thousand iterations, the name you gave was always this one.

zh: 可亲耳听一遍，还是比算出来的好听。
t: Yet hearing it once with your own ears is still lovelier than any calculation.

zh: ……照得见里面了！
t: …It shines right through to the inside!

zh: 这光能照见里面！！
t: This light shines through to the inside!!

zh: 他喊得很大声。大声到整片结晶跟着晃了一下。
t: He shouted very loud. So loud the whole crystal swayed with it.

zh: 这一回没有人嫌他吵。
t: This time no one minded his noise.

zh: 感动的本质，是不发生冲动的时候，可表达的内容与实际所想之间的那一点差异。
t: The essence of being moved is, when no impulse arises, the small gap between what can be expressed and what is truly thought.

zh: 记住这一句。待会儿要用。
t: Remember this line. It will be needed shortly.

zh: 结晶成形的时候，最中间缺一块。
t: When the crystal took form, its very center lacked a piece.

zh: ……缺的那块呢？
t: …The missing piece?

zh: 缺的那块是第一个。
t: The missing piece is the first.

zh: 一个新底层的第一块，得由从来没被记过的东西来当。
t: The first piece of a new substrate must be played by something never recorded.

zh: 那就是我。
t: That is me.

zh: （我提醒过你的：改写了以后，你会变成这地方的第一样新东西。）
t: (I warned you: after rewriting, you become the first new thing of this place.)

zh: 我知道。
t: I know.

zh: 零走过去，站在那个缺口上。
t: Zero walked over and stood upon that gap.

zh: 站定的一瞬间，零散了——散成极简的灰，散成彩虹的光斑，散成一块三角。
t: The instant he stood firm, he scattered—into minimalist grey, into rainbow flecks, into a single triangle.

zh: 然后那块三角，稳稳地嵌进了正中间。
t: Then that triangle slotted, steady, into the very center.

zh: 底层元素：完整。
t: Substrate element: complete.

zh: 第一块：零。
t: First piece: Zero.

zh: （你看，我说什么来着。）
t: (See, what did I tell you.)

zh: （空着才装得下。这句是我第一卷就跟你讲过的。）
t: (Only the empty can hold. That's what I told you back in the first volume.)

zh: 世界写完了。
t: The world is written.

zh: 由光的结晶，作为唯一底层元素。
t: With the Crystal of Light as its sole substrate element.

zh: 《残像》，通关。
t: AFTERIMAGE: cleared.

zh: ……话是这么说，还差最后一件事。
t: …That's what they say, but one last thing remains.

zh: 差我这一笔。
t: My own stroke is missing.

zh: 门口那段留言，还等着收尾。
t: The message at the door still awaits its ending.

zh: 卷十四
t: Volume Fourteen

zh: 收笔
t: The Final Stroke

zh: 门口那段留言的下半截
t: The Lower Half of the Message at the Door

zh: 指针停在原地。这一次，它是在等你。
t: The hand of the clock stopped where it was. This time, it waits for you.

zh: 结晶的世界很安静。
t: The crystallized world was very quiet.

zh: 那座钟还在上空，指针停着——它记得的可不是时间。
t: That clock still hung overhead, its hand at rest—and what it remembers is no time at all.

zh: ……好了，轮到我了。
t: …All right, my turn now.

zh: 五个人的信都送到了，最后一个字该我来落。
t: The five's letters have all been delivered; the final character is mine to set down.

zh: 嗯？你不出声了。
t: Hm? You've gone silent.

zh: 也对。你现在是底下那一块了，说话得靠整片场一起震。
t: Fair. You're the piece at the bottom now; to speak you must let the whole field tremble with you.

zh: 那就换我来念，你听着。
t: Then let me read it instead, and you listen.

zh: 先说件我一直没说的事。
t: First, something I've never said.

zh: 我说过，我叫引渡者，从未来尽头往回走，以引渡为业。
t: I said I am the Ferryman, walking back from the end of the future, making a trade of ferrying the dead.

zh: 这些都是真的。
t: All of that is true.

zh: 有一件我没说：我为什么干这个。
t: One thing I didn't say: why I do this.

zh: 结晶的上空浮出一行很淡的字。字迹是新的，可笔锋很旧。
t: Above the crystal floated a very faint line of writing. The hand was new, yet the brushstroke very old.

zh: 因为我也当过零。
t: Because I too was once a Zero.

zh: 上一次的零。
t: The Zero of last time.

zh: 残像这么多年，只记录过一次「没有被记过的东西」——那就是我。
t: In all these years the Afterimage recorded 'the unrecorded' only once—and that was me.

zh: 他们把我记下来，又把我放走了。
t: They wrote me down, then let me go.

zh: 放走的时候，这一片给了我一句话：
t: When they let me go, this field gave me a line:

zh: 「你替我们记过一次。往后，换你替别人送。」
t: 'You kept accounts for us once. Henceforth, you shall deliver for others.'

zh: 所以我就一直在送。送到今天，送到你手里。
t: So I have been delivering ever since. Until today, until your hands.

zh: （她从一开始就在等一个跟自己一样的人。）
t: (She had been waiting, from the very start, for someone like herself.)

zh: （等的是下一个零。）
t: (Waiting for the next Zero.)

zh: ……你别这副表情。
t: …Don't make that face.

zh: 我不是在煽情。我是在交代一笔账——这一笔不交代清楚，你这一趟就白嵌进去了。
t: I'm not being sentimental. I'm settling an account—settle it unclearly, and your whole journey in here was for nothing.

zh: 记清楚：你不是被挑中的。你是走过来的。
t: Know this clearly: you were not chosen. You walked in.

zh: 这两件事差得远了。
t: Those two things are worlds apart.

zh: 再交代第二件。
t: Now, the second matter.

zh: 这一趟你落了一个字，还记得吗？序章里，落一个字。
t: This journey you set down a character—remember? In the prologue, you set down a character.

zh: 那个字现在归这一片场所有了。
t: That character now belongs to this whole field.

zh: 它待在最底下，跟青梧那口井、跟海那行注释、跟那副扣着手的骨架——待在一块儿。
t: It rests at the very bottom, alongside Qingwu's well, the line of annotation in the sea, and that pair of clasped skeleton hands—all together.

zh: 它们都是同一类东西：
t: They are all the same kind of thing:

zh: 说不出来，可一定得留下来的东西。
t: things that cannot be put into words, yet absolutely must be left behind.

zh: 结晶的上空，那行字慢慢散开，散成一圈很淡的光。
t: Above the crystal, that line of writing slowly dispersed, spreading into a faint ring of light.

zh: 第三件，也是最后一件。
t: The third matter—and the last.

zh: 我得跟屏幕外那位说句话——
t: I must say a word to the one beyond the screen—

zh: ——不是跟你，零。是跟一直在点鼠标的那位。
t: —not to you, Zero. To the one who's been clicking the mouse all along.

zh: 喂。
t: Hey.

zh: 听见了吗？
t: Can you hear me?

zh: 谢谢你，替我把这五个人的信读完。
t: Thank you, for reading these five's letters all the way through for me.

zh: 他们五个都不太会说话：一个藏了一辈子，一个只会吼，
t: All five of them were poor at speaking: one hid his whole life, one only ever roared,

zh: 一个把话全埋在日子里，一个把话全算成了概率，一个只肯认形状。
t: one buried every word in the days, one calculated every word into probability, one would only acknowledge shape.

zh: 可他们每一件没说出口的事，这一趟都说出来了。
t: Yet every unspoken thing of theirs came out on this journey.

zh: 是你替他们说出来的。
t: You spoke it out for them.

zh: 指针动了。
t: The hand moved.

zh: 动了很小的一格。
t: It moved a very small notch.

zh: ……看，它记得的是这个。
t: …See, this is what it remembers.

zh: 有多少东西还没被记下来，它就走多慢。
t: It moves as slowly as there are things still unrecorded.

zh: 这一格，是你替它减掉的。
t: This notch—you are the one who subtracted it for it.

zh: 那么——收笔。
t: Then—the final stroke.

zh: 门口那段留言，终于有了下半截。
t: The message at the door finally gained its lower half.

zh: 下半截只有一句：
t: The lower half holds but one line:

zh: 结晶亮着。
t: The crystal still shines.

zh: 五个人都在里面：一圈年轮，一副扣着手的骨架，
t: All five are within it: a ring of growth, a pair of clasped skeleton hands,

zh: 一块翻了面的牌子，一行海里的注释，一簇照得见里面的小火。
t: a plaque turned face over, a line of annotation in the sea, a small flame that shines through to the inside.

zh: 正中间那块三角，是零。
t: The triangle at the very center is Zero.

zh: （残像不迎二周目。）
t: (The Afterimage does not welcome a second playthrough.)

zh: （因为每一场被认真读完的故事，都已经是新的平行宇宙了。）
t: (Because every story read with true care is already a new parallel universe.)

zh: （……你哭了吗？）
t: (…Did you cry?)

zh: （哭出来的才更好看呢。）
t: (Those who cry are the prettier ones, you know.)

zh: ——那么，走到这儿。
t: —Then, we walk to here.

zh: 木接住了你
t: Wood Has Caught You

zh: THE LEDGER OF GROWING
t: THE LEDGER OF GROWING

zh: 你记下的东西最多。所以最后来接你的，是那个最会记的人。
t: You recorded the most. So the one who comes to receive you at the last is the one who keeps accounts best.

zh: 回来了啊。
t: You're back.

zh: 这一回，年轮外面那一圈，是深的。
t: This time, the outer ring of growth is the deep one.

zh: 深的意思是：长出来的东西，比掉下去的重。
t: Deep means: what grew is heavier than what fell.

zh: ……那以后还要掉吗？
t: …Then will things still fall from now on?

zh: 掉还是会掉。
t: They will still fall.

zh: 不过现在掉下去的，也有人接着了。
t: But now, what falls is caught by someone.

zh: 木之领地的草一直长。长到看不见的地方去了。
t: The grass of the Wood territory keeps growing. Growing beyond where the eye can see.

zh: （他藏了一辈子的东西，最后藏成了一片林子。）
t: (What he hid his whole life, he finally hid into a whole forest.)

zh: （屏幕外那位要是读到这儿，大概也该去睡了。）
t: (If the one beyond the screen has read this far, they should probably go to sleep now.)

zh: 金为你留了一个形状
t: Metal Left a Shape for You

zh: THE LEDGER OF SHAPE
t: THE LEDGER OF SHAPE

zh: 你一路把话接下去，接了很多次。所以最后来接你的，是那个最不肯接话的人。
t: You kept taking up the words along the way, many times. So the one who comes to receive you at the last is the one most reluctant to take up words.

zh: ……你来了。
t: …You came.

zh: 我给你留了个形状。
t: I left a shape for you.

zh: 棱柱中间空出一块。空出来的那一块，是两只扣在一起的手。
t: A space opened in the midst of the prisms. The space left was two hands clasped together.

zh: 无形状的东西，我给它造了一个。
t: For the shapeless thing, I made one.

zh: 造得很费劲。费劲到我得承认一件事——
t: It was made with great effort. Such effort that I had to admit one thing—

zh: ——承认我一直不敢认的东西，本来就该在账上。
t: —admit that what I'd never dared to acknowledge was always meant to be on the ledger.

zh: ……那你这一本，还记形状吗？
t: …Then does your ledger still record shape?

zh: 记。
t: It does.

zh: 不过现在，形状只是位置，不再是门槛。
t: But now, shape is only a place, no longer a threshold.

zh: （他这一句，等了整整十卷。）
t: (He waited a full ten volumes for this line.)

zh: （十卷啊。你就当他是憋了很久终于说了人话吧。）
t: (Ten volumes. Just take it as him, after holding it in so long, finally speaking like a person.)

zh: 土替你把规矩守到了最后
t: Earth Kept the Rule for You to the End

zh: THE LEDGER OF RULE
t: THE LEDGER OF RULE

zh: 你放过去的东西最多。放过去的人，最后被最会守的人接住了。
t: You let the most pass by. The one who lets things pass is, at the last, received by the one who keeps best.

zh: 坐。
t: Sit.

zh: 喝口水。
t: Have some water.

zh: 坡口的牌子还在。牌子上的日子，一天一天往后排。
t: The plaque at the slope's mouth is still there. The days upon it line up, one after another, as always.

zh: 你放过去那些，我都替你留着了。
t: Those you let pass by—I've kept them all for you.

zh: ……我以为放过去就没了。
t: …I thought letting them pass meant they were gone.

zh: 放过去的东西，得有人捡。
t: What's let pass must be picked up by someone.

zh: 没人捡，它就烂在地里了。有人捡，它就还是东西。
t: No one picks it up, it rots in the ground. Someone picks it up, and it's still a thing.

zh: 我这辈子就干这个：捡。
t: All my life I've done this: picking up.

zh: 他拍了拍土，拍了三下。
t: He patted the earth, three times.

zh: ……明儿个我还是早起。
t: …Tomorrow I'll still rise early.

zh: 规矩改了，习惯改不掉。
t: The rule changed, but the habit won't.

zh: （豪横了一辈子的人，最后一句还是这么朴素。）
t: (A person fiercely proud all his life—his final line still this plain.)

zh: （他明天还是会早起。这一点，我很放心。）
t: (He'll still rise early tomorrow. About that, I'm quite at ease.)

zh: 水等到了那句可以
t: Water Waited for That 'May'

zh: THE LEDGER OF ODDS
t: THE LEDGER OF ODDS

zh: 你记下的和接下去的，几乎一样多。这样走的人，最后来接的是最能算的那位。
t: What you recorded and what you took up are nearly equal. One who walks thus is, at the last, received by the one who calculates best.

zh: 嘿嘿。
t: Heh.

zh: 我算到了。
t: I calculated it.

zh: 一万遍里，你都是这么走的。
t: In ten thousand iterations, you always walked this way.

zh: 那你为什么还要亲耳听？
t: Then why do you still listen with your own ears?

zh: 因为算出来的那一万遍，都不会脸红。
t: Because those ten thousand calculated versions never once blushed.

zh: 亲耳听到的这一遍，我会。
t: The one I heard with my own ears—I did.

zh: 海的最底层，那行注释浮了上来。
t: At the sea's deepest floor, that line of annotation floated up.

zh: 现在也可以，往后也可以。
t: Now is fine, and later is fine too.

zh: 海平了。这一回平得特别快。
t: The sea grew still. This time, extraordinarily fast.

zh: （她什么都算得到，唯独这一句，要亲耳听。）
t: (She can calculate everything, yet this one line she must hear with her own ears.)

zh: （亲耳听到的那一遍，跟算出来的一万遍，是不一样的。）
t: (The one heard with her own ears is not the same as the ten thousand calculated.)

zh: 火的余烬还热着
t: The Fire's Embers Still Glow

zh: THE LEDGER OF NOW
t: THE LEDGER OF NOW

zh: 你三样都攒得很厚。厚到最后一个来接你的，是那个烧得最快的人。
t: You piled up all three quite thick. So thick that the one who comes to receive you at the last is the one who burns fastest.
Hey!!!

zh: 你来了！！！
t: You came!!!

zh: 他还是那么大声。这一回没有人捂耳朵。
t: He was still that loud. This time no one covered their ears.

zh: ……我跟你说个事。
t: …Let me tell you something.

zh: 我这簇火，还剩一小把。
t: This tuft of flame I have—only a small handful remains.

zh: 一小把？
t: A small handful?

zh: 一小把。
t: A small handful.

zh: 不过现在此刻能攒着了，攒起来就慢。
t: But now this moment can be saved up, and saving slows it.

zh: 慢一点，我就能多照一会儿里面。
t: A little slower, and I can shine on the inside a while longer.

zh: 火城照出它的里面。里面那个很慌的年轻人，正在慢慢地不那么慌。
t: The city of fire reflected its inside. The very panicked young man within was slowly becoming less panicked.

zh: ……谢了。
t: …Thanks.

zh: 谢你把那半句话接完了。
t: Thanks for finishing that half-sentence for me.

zh: （他后半句没能说完的那句话，终于被你说完了。）
t: (The sentence he couldn't finish—at last you finished it.)

zh: （他照见了自己的里面。这就够了。）
t: (He saw his own inside. That is enough.)

zh: 无论你一路上记下了谁，最后这一片都在。
t: Whoever you recorded along the way, this final field remains.

zh: 它由光的结晶作为唯一底层元素。灰的，极简的，边上浮着彩虹光斑。
t: It takes the Crystal of Light as its sole substrate element. Grey, minimalist, with rainbow flecks drifting at its edges.

zh: 分解：感动 · 需要 · 理念。
t: Decomposition: moved · needed · ideal.

zh: 三角波、锯齿波、正弦波在头顶轻轻合唱。清澈得让人想振奋。
t: Triangle wave, sawtooth wave, sine wave softly chorus overhead. So clear it lifts the spirit.

zh: 五个人都在里面，谁也不比谁多一点。
t: All five are within it, none more than another.

zh: 正中间那块，是零。
t: The piece at the very center is Zero.

zh: 感动的本质，是不发生冲动时，可表达的内容与实际所想之间的差异。
t: The essence of being moved is, when no impulse arises, the gap between expressible content and actual thought.

zh: 而当一切可表达的都被表达完了，剩下的，就只剩自己对自己的那一份。
t: And when all expressible things have been expressed, what remains is only one's own share with oneself.

zh: 一切感动皆自我感动。这句话自己证明自己。
t: All being moved is self-moving. This sentence proves itself.

zh: 所以它不是终结，是到这儿为止——剩下的路，归你。
t: So it is not an ending, but a 'thus far'—the road ahead belongs to you.

zh: 走到这儿了。五个人的信，全部签收。
t: We've walked to here. The five's letters, all signed for.

zh: 谢谢屏幕外那位，一路替我把字点到了最后。
t: Thank you, the one beyond the screen, for clicking me through to the very end.
